name: nguyenthuan2412/swoole-mongo
description: Non-blocking MongoDB driver for PHP and Swoole coroutines (ext-mongodb + mongodb/mongodb compatible API)

suggest.ext-intl: SASLprep for SCRAM-SHA-256 passwords with non ASCII characters

configure-options.name: with-swoole-mongo-gssapi
configure-options.description: Kerberos (GSSAPI) authentication, needs MIT krb5 (libkrb5-dev / brew krb5). Optional value: krb5 prefix

configure-options.name: with-swoole-mongo-mongocrypt
configure-options.description: Client-side field level encryption / Queryable Encryption, needs libmongocrypt >= 1.8 (found with pkg-config)
